items.prompt: 题目是“社区是否应延长图书馆开放时间”。哪一句最适合作为明确立场？

choices.label: The library should stay open later because many residents cannot visit it during working hours.
choices.why: 有明确立场，也给出可展开的理由。

choices.label: Libraries have books, desks and lights.
choices.why: 只是罗列设施，没有回应是否延时。

choices.label: There are many different opinions in the world.
choices.why: 过于空泛，没有进入题目。

items.text: Flexible hours can improve employees’ daily lives.
items.prompt: 哪一项最能直接支持这个中心句？

choices.label: For example, parents may start earlier and leave in time to collect their children.
choices.why: 给出了灵活时间改善生活的具体例子。

choices.label: Some offices were built twenty years ago.
choices.why: 办公楼年龄与中心句无关。

choices.label: Employees use many kinds of computers.
choices.why: 没有解释灵活时间的好处。

items.prompt: 哪句让步既承认限制，又没有放弃“线上课程有价值”的立场？

choices.label: Although online courses require self-discipline, they give many learners access to subjects unavailable locally.
choices.why: 先承认限制，再回到支持线上课程的核心理由。

choices.label: Online courses are useful because they are online.
Online courses have disadvantages, so no one should use them.
choices.why: 结论绝对，也没有保留原立场。

items.prompt: ① The change would cost money. ② It could, however, reduce traffic in the long term. ③ The city is considering cheaper bus tickets. 哪个顺序最自然？

choices.label: ③ → ① → ②
choices.why: 先提出方案，再承认成本，最后用 however 转出长期收益。

choices.label: ② → ③ → ①
choices.why: It 在方案出现前没有清楚指代。

choices.label: ① → ② → ③
choices.why: change 尚未出现，前两句指代悬空。

items.prompt: 一段先说明培训成本，再论证培训能减少长期错误。哪一句最适合收束？

choices.label: Therefore, the initial cost should be viewed as an investment in more reliable work.
choices.why: 概括成本与长期收益之间的论证。

choices.label: There are costs, costs and more costs.
choices.why: 只重复问题，没有完成推论。
